d: In Arizona, an armored van loaded with cash failed to reach its destination. Authorities suspected an inside job. When the vehicle was recovered with the drivers and the cash missing, those suspicions grew even more.
In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

t: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
d: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

An armed robbery is a terrifying ordeal.  When a gang descended on a Los Angeles cash vault, they threatened to kill anyone who resisted.  The violent assault was the largest heist in U.S. history and a piece of plastic was the only evidence.
When gangs go to war, they don't care who gets in the way.  In 1988 an innocent man was gunned down near Cleveland, Ohio, a victim of a deadly initiation.

Smoke, "Kongen af Cali," er den ubesejrede racermester. Hans dominans og titlen udfordres af Kid, et ungt racergeni, i denne historie om moderne vovehalse og det ultimative løb for, at den hurtigste overlever.
A neophyte hacker becomes the target of the FBI after he unknowingly taps into a high-tech embezzling scheme which could cause a horrific environmental disaster in this suspenseful drama.

En ung fyr har vundet den lokale mafiaboss' gunst. Det giver mange fordele, men huer ikke hans far, der er en hæderlig buschauffør. Tingene bliver ikke nemmere, da fyren forelsker sig i en sort pige samtidig med, at der opstår konflikter mellem nogle…

Biologen og den tidligere soldat Lena (Natalie Portman) må lede en mission til en mystisk karantænezone kendt som "The Shimmer", en smuk, men livsfarlig verden af muterede landskaber og dyr, som truer alt liv på Jorden. Oscar Isaac spiller også med.

Efter en næsten fatal pistolkamp mindes Marcus sin rejse fra forældreløs gadebarn i Bronx og en tid med narkohandel til han slutter sig sammen med en anden tidligere kriminel (Terrence Howard) i et forsøg på at blive en succesfuld rapper.

Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.
